summary.text: Susan Lynn is the Republican state representative for Tennessee House District 57, part of Wilson County, who lives in Mount Juliet and is the incumbent on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot.
She served in the House in the 103rd through 106th General Assemblies and again from the 109th, and she took office most recently in November 2012 according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Lynn holds a bachelor's degree in economics, earned with cum laude honors, and certifications in financial management, Six Sigma, continuous quality improvement and LEAN.
The legislature's biography lists her occupation as financial controller, and Ballotpedia says she has worked in regulatory compliance and process improvement.
Lynn is a member of the House Commerce Committee, the Health Committee and the Banking & Consumer Affairs Subcommittee, according to the House website.
She chaired the Finance, Ways, and Means Committee in the 2019-2020 legislative session, according to Ballotpedia.
Her listed affiliations include the Mt. Juliet Chamber of Commerce, the Wilson County Republican Party, the American Legislative Exchange Council and the Heartland Institute Advisory Board.
Ballotpedia reports that she faces Democrat Matt Burchfield in the general election.
